name: Nikhil Solanki
tagline: Homes that feel like a natural extension of the people who live in them.
philosophy: We want people to feel like they truly belong in the spaces they inhabit. Just as the people around us shape our mood, so does the environment we live in.
bio:
We believe the spaces we live in shape the way we feel, move, and experience everyday life. That's why we see interior design as more than creating beautiful spaces — it's about designing environments that feel natural, functional, and deeply personal.

Our approach grew through observation during a home renovation, where we discovered how proportion, material, alignment and execution transform the experience of a space. Today, we bring together light, materials, planning and detailing to create homes connected to the people who live in them.

Good design isn't about telling people how they should live. It's about understanding how they already do — and shaping a home that supports it beautifully.

approach.title: Understand People
approach.description: Every project begins long before the first drawing — with how you already live.

approach.title: Understand the Space
approach.description: Proportion, light, and flow: we read the room before we touch it.

approach.title: Shape the Experience
approach.description: Planning and detailing that make a space feel effortless to move through.

approach.title: Refine the Details
approach.description: Materials, alignment, and execution — where a home becomes personal.

approach.title: Bring It to Life
approach.description: Site coordination and turnkey delivery, built exactly as visualised.

name: Ensio.Co Design Studio
tagline: The bridge between concept and reality.
philosophy: Ensio.Co takes its name from the ensō — the single brushstroke circle that finds beauty in what is left imperfect. We design spaces the same way: complete enough to feel resolved, open enough to feel lived in.
bio:
Ensio.Co is a Mumbai studio of 3D visualisation specialists working at the point where interior design becomes something you can actually see. We build photoreal renders of spaces before a single wall is moved — architectural visualisation, interior sets, product studies and virtual walkthroughs.

Our work is a seamless blend of visual appeal and storytelling. A render is only useful if it answers the questions a drawing can't: how the evening light lands on a marble wall, how a fluted walnut panel reads against brass, whether a nursery feels calm at eye level rather than in plan.

We pair traditional rendering craft — lighting, textures, spatial composition — with the newest tools available, so that what our clients approve on screen is what they walk into on site.

approach.title: Read the Brief
approach.description: Drawings, references and intent — we start by understanding what the space is meant to feel like.

approach.title: Build the Space
approach.description: Accurate 3D geometry from the plan, so proportion and sightlines are honest before anything is styled.

approach.title: Light It
approach.description: Daylight studies and layered artificial light — the part that decides whether a render reads as real.

approach.title: Dress the Materials
approach.description: Stone, veneer, metal and fabric mapped at true scale, tested against each other before they are specified.

approach.title: Tell the Story
approach.description: Camera, composition and final grade — delivered as stills or a walkthrough you can move through.
